 Latest news Next week, certain recipients of Social Security in the U.S. are to be paid their monthly benefits for October 2026.
 Getty Images Social Security Social Security is paid out on Wednesday, October 28: who benefits?
 William Allen Greg Heilman Update: Oct 22nd, 2026 07:00 EDT Share Make us preferred on Google In the U.S., some Social Security beneficiaries are to receive their latest monthly money next week , as the Social Security Administration (SSA) concludes the program’s payment schedule for October 2026 .
 Who receives Social Security on Wednesday, October 28?
 Many of Social Security’s 71.6 million beneficiaries are paid on the second, third or fourth Wednesday in each month , depending on their date of birth.
 October 28 is the fourth Wednesday in October, so Social Security is to be issued to beneficiaries born from the 21st to the 31st of any month . 
 October 2026’s complete three-Wednesdays cycle:
 Born on 1st-10th of any month: paid on Wednesday, October 14 
 Born on 11th-20th of any month: paid on Wednesday, October 21 
 Born on 21st-31st of any month: paid on Wednesday, October 28 
 NB: If you get Social Security based on someone else’s work history, the SSA uses the other person’s birthday .
 What other payment runs are there in October 2026?
 October 28 is the last of four payment dates on this month’s Social Security schedule . At the start of the month, the SSA paid two groups of beneficiaries who are issued their money outside of the three-Wednesdays cycle:
 Friday, October 2: Social Security paid to double beneficiaries and some long-term recipients 
 On Friday, October 2, this month’s Social Security was paid to recipients who began claiming their benefits before May 1997 . Friday 2 was also October’s Social Security distribution date for beneficiaries who concurrently receive Supplemental Security Income (SSI).
 A benefit for certain low-income, low-resource individuals , SSI differs from Social Security as it is needs-based . Unlike Social Security, eligibility for SSI is not dependent on an applicant’s employment record. Worth a monthly average of $735.86, SSI was paid out for October on Thursday 1 . 
 How much are monthly Social Security benefits?
 Retirement: $2,034.54 
 Disability: $1,499.41 
 Survivor: $1,636.31 
 Average benefit , per the SSA .
 How much will the 2027 COLA be?
 In an attempt to protect beneficiaries’ purchasing power, the SSA announced earlier this month that it will increase Social Security and SSI payments by 3.6% in 2027 . 
 Across all Social Security beneficiaries, this translates into a rise of around $70 on the current average payment, which stands at $1,943.15 per month.
 How does the Social Security Admin pay out benefits?
 Direct deposit 
 Social Security beneficiaries can supply the SSA with their bank details on the online “ my Social Security ” tool.
 Direct Express 
 Benefits can be paid onto the Direct Express Card , a special debit card for federal disbursements. Sign up for Direct Express at 1-800-333-1795 or 1-800-772-1213, or at a Social Security office.
